purpose: current-state semantic convergence of authoritative intent vs observed reality, not Git diff/history

monotonic_rule.statement: findings/history are append-only evidence; current state is a projection; no silent delete/rewrite

evidence_refs.rule: evidence refs use stable locators/hashes and reuse Evidence-to-State semantics

residual_to_work_item_rule.statement: only an open finding can generate a candidate work item carrying finding_id/source_ref/remediation/evidence_refs; conversion neither resolves the finding nor authorizes execution/promotion

evaluator_executor_separation.statement: executor may produce evidence/remediation but cannot issue final convergence certificate for its own attempt
evaluator_executor_separation.final_verifier_rule: final verifier role may only be 'supervisor' or 'independent_verifier'; when executor_id is supplied, final verifier.id MUST differ from that executor identity regardless of whether the verifier role is 'supervisor' or 'independent_verifier'

converged_proof_requirements: no self-certification regardless of verifier role
certificate.set_coverage_rule: set-like identity/reference arrays (finding_refs, open_finding_ids, verification_scope.source_refs, and the finding_id values of supplied findings) MUST NOT contain duplicates; duplicates are rejected rather than deduplicated so they cannot fake exact set coverage
certificate.scope: certificate is derived verification judgment only; it does not close task; final close still requires existing completion gate acceptance='verified' and other requirements
